method: Read-only consolidation of existing v0.2/v0.3 records plus fresh offline original-byte replay; no new data acquisition. All eight statuses are production field scope, separate from source array structure.

status_definitions.READY: Required fact and exact admitted binding are present for the stated field scope; never whole-product admission by itself.
status_definitions.PARTIAL: Sourced facts/candidates exist but the complete production binding is not admitted.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Required production join cannot admit this exact provider series.
status_definitions.NOT_AVAILABLE: Required evidence is absent in the retained sources; no invented replacement.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Exact epistemic state cannot be established from retained evidence; no guessed state.

representation_changes: Existing identity/time and basis/action facts projected into the eight requested priority fields.
Composite listing field remains BLOCKED; eighteen NOT_AVAILABLE histories and one PARTIAL GEV history remain explicit subfacts.
Exact quote-state value UNKNOWN is used as the v0.4 state; old evidence readiness NOT_AVAILABLE is retained by reference. This is not a status promotion.

temporal_semantics.bar_timestamp: Preserved provider bar label only; actual event/open role is UNKNOWN.
temporal_semantics.bar_date: Derived under declared provider IANA timezone; not an admitted session ID.
temporal_semantics.session_time: Candidate authority rules/notices only until dated join admitted.
temporal_semantics.market_close: Per-bar actual close NOT_AVAILABLE; market close != available_at.
temporal_semantics.provider_timestamp: Latest regularMarketTime only; historical publication/finality UNKNOWN.
temporal_semantics.observed_at: Current acquisition observation windows; never historical availability.
temporal_semantics.available_at: Historical per-bar evidence NOT_AVAILABLE; stored unknown/null facts retained.
temporal_semantics.knowledge_time: Historical UNKNOWN; current observation bounds remain explicit.
temporal_semantics.ingestion_time: Separate persisted_at where explicitly captured; absent values are not inferred.

existing_reference_tree_caveat.sessions_binder_listing_calendar: References in v0.3 are Integration-only at the historical read-only tree. These paths are absent from Chart baseline 581c61c; no current Chart implementation or new merge is claimed.
